title_zh: 选定缓坡下山路线并约好同行

scenario.label_zh: 选定下山路线并约好同行
scenario.goal_zh: 比较两条下山路线，并决定一起沿有标记的缓坡返回

context_zh: 两名徒步者在山脊的路线牌前准备返回游客中心。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: Do we descend by the steps or take the longer path?

sentences.speaker: Ken
sentences.text: The sign says the steps are steep. I would rather take a gentler descent.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: The longer route follows the blue markers and ends at the visitor centre. Does that suit you?

sentences.speaker: Ken
sentences.text: Yes. I am not in a hurry, but I would prefer not to walk back alone.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: I will stay with you. Let us take the blue route and keep the same pace.

sentences.speaker: Ken
sentences.text: Thanks. I can see the first marker beside that gate.
